Name: Willy to Milly Dialogue and Gender change
Author: upforkilling
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size][color=#D4D4D8]
This mod changes Willy into Milly and changes their gender to Female.
It also adds more dialogue I have given Milly 10 new lines of Heart level related Daily Dialogues.
Best enjoyed with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38409]willy girl mod[/url] It will work without it, but why would you use it... [/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Place unzipped mod in mods folder [/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Gender and name swap.
10 new lines of Hear level Daily Dialogue.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Content Patcher
SMAPI - Stardew Modding API [/color]
